authority.scope: Develop spatially braced CFRP tripod/quadpod alternatives and retain larger-section unbraced comparisons. No component, dimension, spine count, landing-gear arrangement, procurement or review baseline is selected.

evidence_boundary.reason_for_development: The inspected intermediate-layout 2 kg first-contact sensitivity for unbraced 8/6 mm legs has stored linear displacement/span ratios approximately 0.18 to 0.50 across hypothetical moduli. These invalidate a small-deflection acceptance interpretation; they are not measured failure or CFRP strength evidence.

units_and_frames.geometry: mm in CAD coordinates: +X forward, +Y left, +Z upward
units_and_frames.analysis: Convert lengths to m before stiffness, force, moment, energy or mass calculations; N, N m, Pa, kg and rad thereafter.
units_and_frames.body_origin: Retain the fixed-datum versus instantaneous-CG distinction; complete-vehicle CG is not supplied by this configuration.

topologies.purpose: Larger-section exploratory leg comparator; supplier suitability not established

bounded_search.first_pass: Cartesian product of the two geometry hypotheses, two landing arrangements and six topologies only: 24 topology instances, before stated load/material sensitivities.
deferred: 30 degree brace-root spread as a conditioning sensitivity
Single-brace diagnostic retaining main-leg/root bending support
Alternative ring radii or attachment heights
bounded_search.rule: Do not expand geometry automatically to manufacture a pass. Retain failures and governing witnesses.

node_and_connectivity_rules.angle_convention: phi and theta are converted from degrees to radians before trigonometry
node_and_connectivity_rules.main_member: One continuous tube A-F. In braced models split its beam mesh at J with continuous translations and rotations, not an unintended hinge.
node_and_connectivity_rules.brace_members: B_plus-J and B_minus-J, each compression/tension-capable tube in the ideal model; no pretension assumed.
node_and_connectivity_rules.unbraced_mesh_comparison: Mesh subdivision alone must not change the unbraced solution.
node_and_connectivity_rules.contact_offset: Transmit force F_contact at C to F_socket with the additional couple (C-F_socket) cross F_contact.
node_and_connectivity_rules.shared_root_rule: Merge coincident ideal root coordinates for reaction aggregation. Tripod theta=60 degrees and quadpod theta=45 degrees have shared brace roots. Do not count shared connectors as two independent supports or claim their physical packaging is resolved.
node_and_connectivity_rules.moving_group: All new landing members and attachment roots are fixed to the airframe; they are not gimbal-carried.

sections_and_material_sensitivities.provenance: Inherited hypothetical CFRP sensitivity values, not supplier laminate properties or measured allowables.
sections_and_material_sensitivities.restriction: Isotropic-equivalent section stress and stiffness calculations are screening proxies, not composite failure criteria. Do not infer a Poisson ratio or laminate from independently varied E and G.

structural_analysis_contract.main_leg: Linear 3D beam with axial, biaxial bending and torsional response; document element formulation, local axes and mesh convergence.
structural_analysis_contract.braces: Pin-ended axial members in the ideal baseline. They restrain translations at J but provide no independent rotational restraint there.
structural_analysis_contract.baseline_boundary: Ring roots have fixed translations. Main root A is ideally clamped. Brace root/end rotations are not artificial beam constraints. This is a rigid-ring substructure fixture, not a model of qualified joints or the complete vehicle.
structural_analysis_contract.release_diagnostic: Repeat with an explicitly spherical main-root connection: root translations fixed, all root rotations released. Report any rotational or translational mechanism; do not stabilize it with arbitrary springs. A revolute hinge is a different interface and is not substituted silently.
structural_analysis_contract.unused_dofs: Remove genuinely unused truss rotational DOFs by formulation; distinguish them from physical mechanisms in the assembled beam structure.
structural_analysis_contract.compliance: Ring, clamp and brace-junction compliance remain unresolved. Future finite-stiffness cases require labelled assumed or measured values and cannot inherit ideal-boundary acceptance.
structural_analysis_contract.load_introduction: Ideal brace axes meet the main centerline at J. Actual lug offsets, bearing/crushing, clamp slip, adhesive/insert loads and local tube bending remain separate unresolved demands.
structural_analysis_contract.buckling: Report compression in every member. Brace Euler K=1 and K=2 sensitivities are ideal comparisons only. Do not presume J supplies a full lateral pin support for main-leg buckling; examine directional restraint and unsupported J-F bending. Stability and large-displacement analysis remain required where linear screens are inadequate.
required_reports: Member forces and moments with signs and local axes
Root resultant force and moment about a stated datum
Section stress proxies with no unsupported strength pass

landing_load_hypotheses.mass_rule: Each mass is an assumed complete vehicle mass including all structure and equipment. Do not add calculated tube mass again to the same load case.
landing_load_hypotheses.vertical_reaction_formula: Fz = m*g + k*m*vz^2/(2*s), with s in m; k multiplies only the kinetic stopping term

distribution_cases.other_foot_loads: zero; repeat for each distinct leg/root connectivity

distribution_cases.qualification: Imposed equal sharing reference, not established contact compliance or dynamic load distribution

landing_load_hypotheses.contact_boundary: Apply prescribed forces, not fixed-foot translation constraints. Friction coefficient, surface compliance and unilateral contact evolution are unknown. Lateral-force ratios do not establish that the surface can supply those forces.
landing_load_hypotheses.limits: Point-mass stopping-force sensitivities do not resolve vehicle rotation, rebound, tipping, contact sequencing or coupled landing dynamics. Azimuth sampling is not a continuous maximum.

clearance_contract.retain_parent_gimbal_convention: Rx(alpha)Ry(beta) in body coordinates with separate outer and inner joint origins. Apply the proper CAD/body conjugation and the parent source translation definitions; do not rotate all points about a fictitious common pivot.
add_fixed_envelopes: Complete main-tube and brace-tube outer surfaces
clearance_contract.joint_envelope_status: Unselected non-mass packaging spheres for sensitivity only; not supported hardware envelopes or a demonstration of mountability.
clearance_contract.intentional_connections: Allow incident members to meet only within their declared common joint region. Report unintended member-member, joint-member and moving-fixed intersections separately.
clearance_contract.moving_envelopes: Reuse and identify the parent rotor and complete moving-yoke definitions; newly added members receive new pairwise checks throughout the declared domain.
clearance_contract.ground: Retain the parent consistent feet/vehicle attitude construction and exploratory compression/terrain debits. Unloaded geometry is not loaded clearance.
clearance_contract.evidence_levels: Report sampled witnesses, continuous bounds, assumed envelope consumption and loaded deformation separately. Positive nominal separation does not establish complete geometry or physical acceptance.

mass_and_procurement_contract.main_tube_geometry: Retain the parent's 15 mm extension beyond the root and 5 mm extension beyond the socket for preliminary physical tube length, collision and mass accounting.
mass_and_procurement_contract.brace_tube_geometry: Ideal B-J centerline chord and section define only a preliminary envelope and span-based tube subtotal. Pin-center to actual cut-length offsets, insert overlap and end fittings are unknown.
mass_and_procurement_contract.brace_stock_sensitivity_qualification: Exploratory purchase-length debits added to chord length, not validated finished cuts or fabricated connector dimensions. Report each scenario separately.
mass_and_procurement_contract.whole_purchase_rule: Pack cuts jointly with same-product spine cuts where the parent spine scenario is included; retain offcuts and exact schedules. Do not duplicate independently rounded stock subtotals.
mass_and_procurement_contract.spine_scope: Retain parent one-to-four-spine CFRP/aluminium comparisons; no spine elimination or selection follows from this leg study.
mass_and_procurement_contract.accounting: Separate physical tube mass from non-mass envelopes. Missing joint masses and prices remain null, not zero. PETG filament cost is exempt, but installed PETG mass and structural effects still count. Tube subtotals alone cannot establish the AUD 500 vehicle requirement.

source_observations.currency: AUD inferred in retained source; not explicitly confirmed
AUD inferred in retained source; not explicitly confirmed

verification_program_requirements.artifact_binding: Retain the editable analysis and checker sources. Hash actual configuration/source/result inputs and include every tested artifact Ref in verify_command inputs.
checks: Node coordinates, connectivity, shared-root aggregation and unit conversion
Independent axial-bar and cantilever-beam analytical fixtures
Unbraced invariance under beam mesh subdivision
Stiffness symmetry and physically meaningful rank
Deliberate mechanism detected without artificial regularization
Force and moment equilibrium including foot/socket eccentricity
Whole-stock packing and nonduplicated mass ownership
verification_program_requirements.numeric_test_tolerances: Declare dimensional and relative numerical tolerances in the checker before execution; these are software-test tolerances, not human-approved structural limits.
verification_program_requirements.stdout: Exactly one VerificationResult JSON object; diagnostics on stderr.
verification_program_requirements.unknown_physical_checks: Material/joint strength, loaded geometry, complete mass/budget and landing qualification remain null or unperformed until supported; numerical fixture passes cannot turn them into passes.
